neural_repeat_seed_rule: Separate named neural input streams seeded by environment seed and group; repeat index 0.
learned_inference: Deterministic latent mean, fixed weights, recurrent state evolves within episodes.
reaction_definition: First post-onset applied escape drive >=0.5 and at least 0.2 above the fixed mean of the five action windows immediately before onset. A motor response, not proof of successful avoidance. No response is null; preactivated drive is reported separately.
resource_accounting: One evaluation process and one shared full CSR. Wall budget includes loading, episodes and statistics, accumulated across resumes in atomic budget.json. An unclosed operation reservation is charged conservatively after abrupt interruption. Memory/disk/cancel checks run between action windows. Controlled cancellation preserves partial raw trajectories; failed, timed-out or interrupted records remain incomplete and are never replaced during resume.
termination: Fixed duration, with a separate 120 second wall-time timeout status. No automatic food replenishment; C_relocation has one explicitly recorded resource replacement.
comparison_unit: Matched independent single-body environments; learned training seed is not replaced by episodes or frames.
statistics: 2000 bootstrap draws using independent named streams per contrast. Environment-seed bootstrap for individual models; crossed resampling of three training seeds and the same matched environment indices for architecture contrasts. Use the complete shared environment intersection and publish excluded seeds with reasons. No simulation frame is an independent sample.
test_access: Results created once per frozen lock. Exact matching completed records may resume after integrity verification; changed source or protocol requires a new experiment version.
A_baseline: Stimuli are already visible and stationary before step 10. All A conditions use the same initial radius, uniformly 1.0 to 1.5 units. At onset only the specified growth or movement begins; static controls stay still. Direction is specified relative to the initial body; actual onset bearing and distance are recorded separately.
A_scope: A thresholded motor response to an engineered local projection-change encoder. Self-motion can produce retinal changes in static controls. Expansion selectivity in this encoder is not a connectome discovery, and GF readout supplies no escape direction.
C_occlusion: Food distance 7 to 11 units; one midpoint obstacle of radius 1 avoids initially overlapping the body.
C_relocation: At action step 75 remove the original resource, recording its unconsumed remainder, and add exactly one food unit at a preselected new position. The added amount, position and time are identical across matched controllers. Recovery is first additional consumption, timed at the end of the action window, rather than proof of remembered food position.
C_unseen_scope: One new three-obstacle arrangement and second food resource, compared with the training distribution's single-obstacle scenes. This is a bounded scene change and does not establish general out-of-distribution performance.
energy_metrics: Motor energy demand is the sum of dt*(0.001+0.003*forward+0.015*escape+0.001*abs(turn)), in simulation units. It is requested action cost before the body's zero-energy floor. Final stored energy is separate. Food credit discarded at the energy ceiling is not motor expenditure. Physical threat debit is unmeasured at body substeps and reported as null with an explicit status.
missing_data: NPZ uses NaN for non-applicable neural or policy-likelihood channels; JSON uses null. Timeout and backend failure preserve partial trajectories and explicit status. Incomplete cases prevent the overall experiment from being marked completed. Undefined outcomes are not zero.
raw_metric_validation: Initial world, completed observations, raw learned actions/log probabilities, applied actions, bodies, neural rates, inference timings and sampled RSS are retained. Summary generation verifies trajectory checksums and recomputes supported outcomes at 1e-10 absolute/relative arithmetic tolerance.
memory_metrics: Process RSS sampled before the episode and after completed action windows. This is a sampled peak, not a guarantee that all transient allocations were observed.
